rule: A skater with 60+ points, 20+ goals or 40+ assists last regular season is listed in that category when his drought reaches either the tier bar from last season's total (points 100+ -> 2, 85-99 -> 3, 70-84 -> 4, 60-69 -> 5; goals 40+ -> 4, 25-39 -> 8, 20-24 -> 10; assists 60+ -> 3, 40-59 -> 4) or, for points and assists, the surprise bar from his own prior-season hit rate p, the smallest n with (1 - p)^n <= 0.05; the wager is the over 0.5.
